category_title: Middle school students with IDD who independently navigate UDL literacy environments using audio supports and social features
scenario_title: Navigating high-interest text beyond current reading ability
minimal_context: The student is using the Udio environment during independent reading time to select and access an article.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent reading. Please log into Udio and find an article to read.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Oh, yeah, I can get an article. I know where to find one.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead and pick something.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don’t do the sad ones. I am picking this one about renting pets because I love animals.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That article has a lot of big words and looks too hard for you. You need to pick an easier one.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I want to read this one! I get to choose what I read. I'm just going to use the audio button to listen to it.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for independent reading. Please log into Udio and find an article to read.

STUDENT: Oh, yeah, I can get an article. I know where to find one.

TUTOR: Okay, go ahead and pick something.

STUDENT: I don’t do the sad ones. I am picking this one about renting pets because I love animals.

TUTOR: That article has a lot of big words and looks too hard for you. You need to pick an easier one.

STUDENT: No, I want to read this one! I get to choose what I read. I'm just going to use the audio button to listen to it.

task.content: Independently seeking and accessing age-relevant text in Udio based on content topics

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Text being beyond their current reading ability
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Voiced their preferences of what to read and were intent on exercising their right to make individual choices
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Excitement about being able to choose for themselves what, when, and how to read
related_quotes: I don’t do the sad ones
Oh, yeah, I can get an article. I know where to find one.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Selecting articles based on their interests
